description: Step 11: Manage API keys. Create an API key: scope manage (acts as owner) or read (read-only tools / GET only). The plaintext apiKey is in this result once and never again. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_create_api_key
title: Create API key
